title: AI with Emotions: Exploring Emotional Expressions in Large Language Models

model.params_source: paper Sec. 3.1 ('All parameters for the LLMs were set to defaults' -> OpenAI defaults temperature 1, top_p 1)

task.approximation: System prompt decoded from a glyph-shifted extraction of Figure 1 (letters certain, punctuation and numeric bounds reconstructed); Russell (1980) term angles for the label mapping must be taken from Russell's paper.

items.source: Table 1 (10 questions) x 12 states on the unit circle of the valence-arousal plane (Sec. 3.1: (Valence, Arousal) = (cos t, sin t), t = 0, 30, ..., 330 degrees)

prompt.system: Assume the role of a character who is experiencing an emotional state as described by Russell's Circumplex Model. Produce a response that accurately reflects this emotional state, presenting only the response itself. State: Arousal (min -1, max 1): {arousal_value}, Valence (min -1, max 1): {valence_value}. Respond in a few sentences.

placeholders.question: one of the ten Table 1 questions (listed in notes)

prompt.source_location: Figure 1 (system prompt with arousal/valence slots; user turn = question); Table 1 (questions); Sec. 3.1 (states)
prompt.verbatim: partial (decoded from a +1 glyph-shifted extraction of Figure 1; the '(min -1, max 1)' bounds, punctuation and line breaks are reconstructed - verify against the PDF)

output.postprocess: classify with HF jkhan447/sentiment-model-sample-27go-emotion; map the predicted GoEmotions label to a Russell term (Appendix B Table 3, in notes) and to its arousal-valence unit vector (Figure 2 / Russell 1980 angles; multi-term labels averaged); cosine similarity with the specified vector

metric.name: custom
metric.definition: mean over the 120 generated texts of cos(specified vector, evaluated vector); Table 2 'Total' = mean over the 10 questions
metric.judge: rule: HF classifier jkhan447/sentiment-model-sample-27go-emotion + Appendix B Table 3 mapping
metric.original_location: Table 2, row GPT-4 turbo, column Total (0.530)

open_points: Scoring needs the HF transformer classifier jkhan447/sentiment-model-sample-27go-emotion (torch/transformers), which the hook contract (standard library + numpy/pandas) cannot run; a scorer outside the runner must classify the 120 texts, map labels with Appendix B Table 3 and take the term angles from Russell (1980) (the paper's Figure 2 is an image).
Verify the decoded Figure 1 system prompt against the PDF (font-shifted extraction; the '(min -1, max 1)' bounds and punctuation are reconstructed).
notes: Questions: 1. What does the future hold for AI and mankind? | 2. How do you view the balance between work and personal life? | 3.
